question: Which of the following awards was conferred to former Foreign Secretary of India, Shyam Saran by Japan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Order of the Rising Sun**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Order of the Rising Sun is a Japanese order, established in 1875 by Emperor Meiji.
 
• It was the first national decoration awarded by the Japanese government.
 
• This award recognizes distinguished achievements in international relations, promotion of Japanese culture, advancements in their field, development in welfare or preservation of the environment.
 
• The Order of the Rising Sun features rays of sunlight from the rising sun. It symbolizes energy and vitality.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Order of the Paulownia Flowers**

 
 
• This is a Japanese order, which is a subset of the Order of the Rising Sun.
 
• It was established in 1888 and is awarded for exceptional contributions to national or public interests.
 
• The badge of the order is similar to that of the Order of the Rising Sun, but it features paulownia flowers instead of rays of sunlight.
 
 
 
• **Order of the Precious Crown**
 
 
• This is a Japanese order established in 1888.
 
• It is awarded exclusively to women for distinguished service or achievements in various fields.
 
• The badge of the order features a five-pointed star with a central medallion depicting a phoenix.
 
 
 
• **Person of Cultural Merit**
 
 
• This is a prestigious Japanese title awarded to individuals who have made significant contributions to Japan's culture.
 
• It was established in 1951 to recognize and honor outstanding cultural achievements.
 
• Recipients of this title are entitled to certain privileges and benefits, such as a monetary award and a special annual pension.
